title: Task Manager App
description: A drag-and-drop task board with user accounts, built to practice full-stack CRUD operations and session-based authentication.

title: Weather Dashboard
description: Pulls live weather data from a public API and displays a 5-day forecast with animated icons and unit toggling.

title: Recipe Sharing Site
description: A community recipe board where users can submit, rate, and filter recipes by category, stored in a MySQL database.

title: Personal Budget Tracker
description: Tracks income and expenses with category breakdowns and a simple chart view, using vanilla JS and localStorage-free state.
